rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unusual or out of the ordinary, including 特別嘅情況.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 zan1 hai6 dak6 bit6

rows.note: Use this when extraordinary means remarkably good or impressive in quality or performance.

example.english: Your report this time is truly extraordinary.
example.traditional: 你今次份報告真係出色喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan1 hai6 ceot1 sik1 wo3

rows.note: Use this for an extraordinarily great or important person, work, or achievement rather than for ordinary praise.

example.traditional: 呢位醫生嘅貢獻非常偉大。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 ji1 sang1 ge3 gung3 hin3 fei1 soeng4 wai5 daai6
